description.default: The site-relative path of the secured subject access request folder inside rev_SpoSiteUrl, where REV | Retention | Retention & Erasure Helper (SAR extract) writes one extract file and the signed PDF copies per request (TAD rev 33 section 12, A-SAR-9). The folder has its own permissions: the service identity and the process-owner group only. One folder per environment, so this value differs per environment and is supplied per environment, never committed (C-TECH-047).

hint.default: Site-relative path of THIS environment's secured SAR folder, for example /Shared Documents/SAR-DEV. Never point two environments at one folder, and never at a folder others can open.
